newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak real Jan retail sales rise 8.7 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Slovak real Jan retail sales rise 8.7 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Real retail sales in Slovakia rose 8.7 percent, year-on-year, in January, compared to a 16.3 percent increase for the same month in the previous year, the Statistical Bureau (SUSR) said on Tuesday.
SUSR said retail sales totalled 24.2 billion crowns in January 1997, compared with 21.0 billion crowns in January 1996. The statement did not disclose any further details.
Slovakia's retail sales rose by 6.9 percent in real terms in 1996 compared with 1995.
